shape_hint: Headless (grub) set screw: a plain fully threaded cylinder with a single straight screwdriver slot cut across one end face (slot width n, depth t), and a shaped point at the other end - flat (dia dp), cone (small tip dt), long dog (full-diameter pin dp, length z) or cup (concave end, rim dia dz).

role_map.dp_max: max diameter of the flat point and of the dog point
role_map.dt_max: max diameter of the tip of the cone point
role_map.dz_max: max diameter of the cup point
